poly-venezuela-election-scheduled-by-dec.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Venezuela's authorities formally schedule a national election before the end of 2026. Its price is what traders will stake on a vote being called, not on one being held.
poly-venezuela-election-scheduled-by-dec.recent: Venezuelans marched in Caracas on Thursday to demand that a presidential election date be named, and no date followed. Nothing else in the fortnight's reporting touched Venezuela's electoral calendar, so the protests show the demand being made in the street rather than any step toward meeting it.

poly-us-iran-ceasefire-continues-through.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the ceasefire between the United States and Iran survives until the US midterm elections. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves on strikes, threats and mediation.
poly-us-iran-ceasefire-continues-through.recent: Bets on the truce firmed after Israel's army chief reportedly warned Washington off striking Iran, and after Saudi Arabia's defence minister met Iran's president in Tehran. Khamenei then backed Tehran's conditions for peace talks, and an unpublished Pentagon estimate put the war above $47 billion a week before the midterms.

stocks:000660.KS.standing: South Korea's second-largest chipmaker and one of the world's two biggest makers of memory chips. It leads in high-bandwidth memory, the stacked DRAM beside AI accelerators, so its shares trade on AI data-centre spending.
stocks:000660.KS.recent: On 2026-10-23 SK hynix cancelled the Solidigm listing, which was worth up to $15 billion, while its own US listing traded underwater. None of the fortnight's reports on the company explains the fall that came before it.

stocks:MRNA.standing: The Massachusetts biotech built on messenger RNA, the technology behind its Covid-19 vaccine. As Covid sales have shrunk, its value has come to rest on whether mRNA works against cancer and other diseases.
stocks:MRNA.recent: The shares climbed into the reveal of its melanoma vaccine data with Merck, which the partners had already called an initial success. At ESMO the vaccine cut melanoma relapse or death 42%, a result oncologists cheered and the shares slid on.

stocks:MRK.standing: Shares of Merck & Co., the US drugmaker whose cancer immunotherapy Keytruda is among the world's best-selling medicines. That makes the stock a running verdict on how Merck replaces it in its oncology pipeline.
stocks:MRK.recent: Merck's news this fortnight was its melanoma vaccine with Moderna: the shot cut relapse or death 42% in a phase 3 trial, reported on 2026-10-23, after the chart's last reading. Moderna's shares fell on the data. Nothing in the input explains Merck's own price over the window.

stocks:C.standing: One of the four largest US banks, and the most international of them, with operations in about 90 countries. Its shares trade on interest margins, credit losses and a multi-year overhaul ordered by US regulators.

stocks:FM.TO.standing: A Vancouver-based copper miner listed in Toronto, producing mainly from the Kansanshi and Sentinel mines in Zambia. Its shares move with the copper price and with the fate of its Cobre Panamá mine in Panama.
stocks:FM.TO.recent: The one company-specific item in the fortnight was First Quantum preparing to seek state-backed tax breaks under Argentina's RIGI regime for Taca Taca, a $5.25 billion copper project. Nothing in it accounts for the fall in the share.

stocks:INTC.standing: Intel designs PC and server processors and, unlike most chip companies, makes them in its own fabs. It is the US government's main bet on rebuilding leading-edge chip manufacturing at home.
stocks:INTC.recent: The one story about Intel's own business was regulatory: it won a waiver from the US ban on foreign-made robots after saying no US-made robot fits its fabs. That waiver came after the fall, and nothing else in the input explains why the shares dropped.

stocks:RHHBY.standing: Roche, the Basel drug and diagnostics group, priced in dollars. It is the world's largest maker of diagnostic tests, and its earnings rest on cancer medicines and the multiple sclerosis drug Ocrevus.

stocks:NVS.standing: Novartis, the Basel-based drugmaker, as its shares trade in New York. Its earnings rest on a few patented medicines, so trial readouts and patent expiries move it more than the economy does.
stocks:NVS.recent: Novartis's pill remibrutinib cut multiple sclerosis relapses 35.2% and 31.2% against teriflunomide in pivotal trials, results that landed after the chart's last close. It trails Roche's rival BTK inhibitor on efficacy but has a better safety profile, and in the first new MS drug class in years a liver-safety edge can decide which one patients get.

stocks:SNY.standing: The Nasdaq-listed American depositary shares of Sanofi, the Paris drugmaker. Its earnings lean heavily on Dupixent, an antibody for eczema and asthma, alongside one of the world's largest vaccine businesses.
stocks:SNY.recent: Sanofi settled an EU antitrust probe in mid-October, the only news about its own business in the fortnight. Nothing reported gives the terms of the settlement or ties it to the share price.

poly-will-any-country-join-the-mecca-agr.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if any further country formally joins the Mecca Agreement before the end of 2026. Its price is what traders will stake on the pact widening beyond its founding signatories.

poly-will-the-republicans-win-the-texas-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the Republican candidate wins Texas's US Senate race in November 2026. Texas has not elected a Democrat to the Senate since 1988, so the price shows how far traders bet against that record.

stocks:D05.SI.standing: Southeast Asia's largest bank by assets, headquartered in Singapore and partly owned by the state investor Temasek. Its earnings rise and fall with interest rates, so its shares track the cost of money across the region.

stocks:BEN.standing: The listed parent of Franklin Templeton, one of the largest US asset managers. It earns fees on the money it runs, so its shares rise and fall with market levels and with whether clients add to its funds or pull out.
stocks:BEN.recent: The one story in the fortnight about Franklin's own business was about its tokenized fund: the firm keeps the power to freeze about $200 million of its own tokens. It came after the window closed, and nothing in the input accounts for the share's slide before then.

stocks:ASML.standing: The Dutch company that builds the lithography machines chipmakers use to print circuits onto silicon, and the only maker of the extreme-ultraviolet tools that the most advanced chips require.
stocks:ASML.recent: Customers were asking for lithography tools for delivery in 2029 and 2030, and chip equipment sales to China rose 109%, lifting China's share of sales from 14% to 23% despite a US push for export curbs. Both are signs of demand, and neither accounts for the slide in the share.

stocks:7751.T.standing: Shares of the Tokyo-based maker of cameras, office printers and medical scanners, which also builds the lithography tools used to pattern chips. Most of its sales are abroad, so a weaker yen lifts its earnings.

stocks:7731.T.standing: Japan's camera and optics maker, listed in Tokyo, which also builds lithography steppers for chip and flat-panel factories. Its earnings swing with consumer camera demand and with the spending cycle of display and semiconductor plants.

poly-cuban-regime-falls-in-2026.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Cuba's communist government loses power before the end of 2026. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, set against a one-party state that has outlasted decades of US sanctions.

stocks:GS.standing: Shares of Goldman Sachs, the New York investment bank that advises on mergers, underwrites stock and bond sales and trades for clients. Its earnings rise and fall with dealmaking and market turnover.

stocks:NOK.standing: Nokia makes the radio, optical and IP networking equipment that mobile operators and data-centre builders buy, listed in Helsinki and traded in New York. Its share tracks operator capital spending and the cloud networking it has pushed into.

stocks:HSAI.standing: A Shanghai maker of lidar, the laser sensors that let cars and robots map their surroundings, listed on Nasdaq. Chinese carmakers are its main buyers, and US scrutiny of Chinese tech firms hangs over the listing.
stocks:HSAI.recent: The one piece of company news came after the slide: Hesai launched Kosmo, a lidar built for robots, on the back of 142,400 robot lidars shipped in the second quarter, up 193.4%. Nothing reported about Hesai's own business accounts for the fall in its shares.

wiki-flavio-bolsonaro.standing: The daily readership of the Wikipedia article on Flávio Bolsonaro, the Rio de Janeiro senator and eldest son of former president Jair Bolsonaro, who carries his father's movement on Brazil's right.
wiki-flavio-bolsonaro.recent: Lula overturned a first-round deficit in the runoff and won with 4.4 million votes to spare, after two polls had put Flávio Bolsonaro ahead 51% to 49%. A day later Bolsonaro left Brazil through no regular border post, a police official said, and Trump aide Simon Levy confirmed political asylum in the US; Lula called the flight shameful.

stocks:JPM.standing: The largest bank in the United States by assets, spanning Chase's consumer branches, corporate lending and one of Wall Street's biggest investment banks. Its results are read as a check on American borrowers.
stocks:JPM.recent: The CBN granted JPMorgan approval-in-principle to set up a merchant bank in Nigeria, the first licensing step for a firm present in Lagos since 1961. That came after the latest reading, and nothing else in the input is about JPMorgan's own business, so none of it accounts for the share's slide.

stocks:MS.standing: Morgan Stanley, the New York investment bank and one of Wall Street's largest wealth managers. Its profits lean on trading, dealmaking and fees on client assets, so its share tracks how busy and how high markets are.
stocks:MS.recent: The one item in the fortnight about the bank's own business had Morgan Stanley, alongside Goldman Sachs and Wells Fargo, calling tokenization a growth play rather than a threat. Nothing in it accounts for the fall in the share.

stocks:VWAGY.standing: Volkswagen's shares, priced in dollars on the US over-the-counter market. Europe's biggest carmaker owns Audi, Porsche and Skoda, and its earnings ride on sales in China and on tariffs between Europe and the US.
stocks:VWAGY.recent: Audi, the group's premium brand, will build 200,000 cars a year in Georgia, a plant Trump claims as a tariff win at Perry. The announcement came after the latest close shown, so it does not account for the slide.

poly-will-peter-obi-win-the-2027-nigeria.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Peter Obi, the former Anambra governor who ran third in 2023, wins Nigeria's presidency in 2027. Its price is what traders will pay on an opposition upset of the ruling APC.
poly-will-peter-obi-win-the-2027-nigeria.recent: Tinubu launched his re-election bid in Kaduna with petrol at about 1,400 naira a litre in September, the economic pain any challenger campaigns against. Microsoft pledged to load Nigeria's candidate list into its AI systems. Nothing in the news concerned Obi himself, and none of it accounts for the price.

poly-france-declares-state-of-emergency-.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether France declares a state of emergency, the 1955 power letting the government ban gatherings, restrict movement and order searches without a judge. Paris used it after the 2015 attacks.

poly-will-the-democrats-win-the-ohio-sen.standing: What traders on Polymarket pay for a contract that settles at 100 if a Democrat wins Ohio's 2026 US Senate race. Ohio has leaned Republican in recent statewide contests, so the seat bears on which party controls the Senate.

stocks:LLOY.L.standing: Britain's largest mortgage lender, owner of Halifax and Bank of Scotland. Almost all its lending is domestic, so its shares trade as a bet on UK interest rates, house prices and household credit.

poly-will-the-democratic-party-control-t.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Democrats win a majority in the US House of Representatives at the 2026 midterm elections. Its price is what traders pay for that outcome, and House control decides whether a president's agenda can pass.
poly-will-the-democratic-party-control-t.recent: The one American election story of the fortnight was the charging of former FBI officials over 2023 testimony, landing 11 days before the midterms. Nothing in it accounts for what traders are paying on the House.

poly-netanyahu-out-before-2027-684-719-2.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Benjamin Netanyahu stops being Israel's prime minister before 2027. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves with coalition crises, court cases and election timing.

poly-sudan-civil-war-ceasefire-by-decemb.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Sudan's army and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces agree a ceasefire before 2026 ends. The war, fought since April 2023, has driven the world's largest displacement crisis.

wiki-benjamin-netanyahu.standing: Daily readers of the Wikipedia article on Benjamin Netanyahu, Israel's longest-serving prime minister. It rises with his elections, wars and trials, which have shaped Israel's politics for three decades.
wiki-benjamin-netanyahu.recent: Israel voted on Tuesday with polls putting Eisenkot 8 to 10 points ahead of Netanyahu, after a campaign in which Trump endorsed him and tied the vote to the war on Iran. In its final week Netanyahu ordered Hebron cordoned after 5 Israelis were wounded, and posted an AI image of a nuclear blast over Tel Aviv warning of a "second Holocaust".

poly-will-anthropic-ipo-by-november-30-2.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Anthropic, the AI company behind the Claude models, lists its shares on a public stock exchange by 30 November 2026. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome.

poly-israel-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-t.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the ceasefire between Israel and Iran is still in force on Oct 31. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it reacts to strike threats, Gulf shipping and diplomacy.
poly-israel-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-t.recent: Tehran moved toward talks: Saudi Arabia's defence minister met Iran's president, and Khamenei backed Tehran's conditions for peace talks, with Qatar mediating between Tehran and Washington. In Israel, the army chief reportedly warned Washington off striking Iran days before an election in which polls put Eisenkot ahead of Netanyahu.

stocks:AMD.standing: A Santa Clara chip designer selling x86 processors for PCs and servers and Instinct accelerators for AI data centres. Its shares price how much AI spending buyers will steer away from Nvidia.
stocks:AMD.recent: AMD was named alongside Nvidia and Broadcom as eyeing up to $5 billion of Meta's $95 billion share sale, Meta's largest ever, raised to pay for AI data centres. That came days after the share's trough, and nothing reported in the fortnight about AMD's own business accounts for the slide.

stocks:JD.standing: One of China's largest online retailers, and unlike most rivals it owns its warehouses and delivery fleet. Its Nasdaq-listed shares trade on Chinese household spending and on Beijing's stance toward platform companies.
stocks:JD.recent: JD ended deposit pre-sales for its 18th Singles' Day, so shoppers no longer pay weeks ahead to lock in a festival discount. It also said running its ad models on Huawei's Kunpeng chips cut inference latency 15%. Neither announcement explains why the shares gave ground across the fortnight.

stocks:AVGO.standing: Designs the custom AI chips and data-centre networking silicon that Google, Meta and other cloud giants build on, and owns VMware's software. Its share price is a read on how much the largest tech firms spend on AI.

poly-will-luiz-inacio-lula-da-silva-win-.standing: A Polymarket parlay that pays only if three separate things happen: Lula wins Brazil's presidency, Gadi Eisenkot becomes Israel's prime minister, and Democrats take the US Senate. If any one leg fails, it pays nothing.
poly-will-luiz-inacio-lula-da-silva-win-.recent: The Israeli leg moved this contract. On the eve of Tuesday's election, polls put Eisenkot 8 to 10 points ahead of Netanyahu. The campaign closed on Pete Hegseth's unannounced visit to Netanyahu and Netanyahu's order to cordon Hebron after a checkpoint shooting. The fortnight's news carried nothing on the other two legs.

wiki-pakistan.standing: Daily readers of Wikipedia's article on Pakistan, the nuclear-armed South Asian state of more than 240 million people. It shows when world events send people looking for the country's basics.
wiki-pakistan.recent: A school roof collapse in Peshawar killed at least 20 children and led Pakistan to order school inspections. Islamabad then removed Khyber Pakhtunkhwa's PTI government and put the province under emergency rule, while Pakistan joined Iran, Saudi Arabia and Türkiye in Tehran, where the Makkah pact states agreed to keep talking.

stocks:HSBA.L.standing: One of the world's largest banks, headquartered in London but earning most of its profit in Asia, chiefly Hong Kong. Its earnings follow interest rates, and its shares trade on its position between China and the West.
stocks:HSBA.L.recent: The slide came before HSBC reported its July-September results, a pretax profit of $9.6 billion, so those figures do not explain it. Nothing else reported about the bank in this period accounts for the fall.

poly-will-david-lisnard-win-the-2027-fre.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if David Lisnard, the centre-right mayor of Cannes, wins France's 2027 presidential election. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome.

stocks:HAPV3.SA.standing: One of Brazil's largest private health-plan operators, running its own hospitals and clinics, and listed on the B3 in São Paulo. Its margins move with medical-cost inflation and with the rules the regulator ANS sets for health plans.
stocks:HAPV3.SA.recent: The only report on Hapvida's own business here appeared after the fall and does not explain it: an Agência Pública investigation found that STF justice André Mendonça ruled twice in the company's favour weeks after meeting one of its executives at a seminar in Frankfurt.

stocks:VOW3.DE.standing: Europe's largest carmaker by sales, owner of Audi, Porsche, Škoda and SEAT, listed in Frankfurt. The Porsche and Piëch families control it and Lower Saxony holds a fifth of its votes, so politics shapes its pay and plants.
stocks:VOW3.DE.recent: Volkswagen plans a pay freeze for 660,000 workers until 2030. Its Audi unit committed $4 billion to a Georgia plant building 200,000 cars a year, announced on Trump's stage under tariff pressure. Audi is also in talks for Huawei to develop its next A8. All of it came after the share's low, and none of it accounts for the price.

stocks:002230.SZ.standing: A Hefei-based maker of speech-recognition and AI software, listed in Shenzhen, whose Spark models sell into Chinese schools and government. On the US entity list since 2019, it is a test of building AI without American chips.
stocks:002230.SZ.recent: iFlytek said it trained its Spark X2.6 model on domestic chips, without Nvidia, and that one training run fell from 4.5 months to 1.2. For a company shut out of American hardware by export controls, that bears directly on its business: it can keep building models on chips it is allowed to buy.

stocks:005930.KS.standing: South Korea's largest company and one of the world's biggest makers of memory chips, smartphones and displays. It carries so much weight in Seoul's stock market that its share price moves the national index with it.

poly-russia-x-ukraine-ceasefire-agreemen.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Russia and Ukraine agree a ceasefire by the end of November 2026. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves with each round of talks and each wave of strikes.
poly-russia-x-ukraine-ceasefire-agreemen.recent: Moscow has ruled out the kind of pause this contract pays on: Putin wants a final settlement from the Abu Dhabi talks, not a short truce, and Lavrov said the war will continue and likely escalate. The one truce announced, for up to 2,000 people in Oleshky, covers a single occupied town.

stocks:SHEL.standing: Shell is a London-based oil and gas major and one of the world's largest traders of liquefied natural gas. Its shares rise and fall with crude and gas prices, and with how much cash it returns to shareholders.
stocks:SHEL.recent: Shell agreed to sell its Nigerian domestic gas business, a distribution arm serving more than 130 customers, to Vaaris Energy. Separately, its Nigerian unit and Chevron's reported identical methane emissions for 2022. Neither is large enough to account for the share price.

wiki-vladimir-putin.standing: Daily readers of the Wikipedia article on Vladimir Putin, who has run Russia as president or prime minister since 2000. It jumps when the Kremlin makes a war decision or he sits down with a Western leader.
wiki-vladimir-putin.recent: The fortnight's stories came after the peak and do not explain it: Putin proposed a summit with Trump and Xi that would seat no Ukrainian, freed Stephen Hubbard during Steve Witkoff's visit, and spoke with Stubb and Støre, the first Nordic leaders to reach him in over a year.

stocks:BAC.standing: The second-largest US bank by assets, holding deposits for tens of millions of American households. Much of that money sits in bonds, so its earnings and share price move with interest rates.
stocks:BAC.recent: The Treasury fined Bank of America $1.21 billion for money-laundering and sanctions failures, including $5 billion in suspicious transactions reported late. The penalty drove an earnings miss, and the stock fell 5% while JPMorgan Chase and Wells Fargo held steady. Its unrealized bond losses have since risen to $109 billion.

stocks:FITB.standing: A Cincinnati-based regional bank lending to households and companies across the US Midwest and Southeast. Its share price turns on the gap between what it pays depositors and what it earns on loans, so it answers to Fed rate moves.

poly-russia-x-ukraine-ceasefire-agreemen.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Russia and Ukraine agree a ceasefire before the end of 2026. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves on talks, envoys and sanctions decisions.
poly-russia-x-ukraine-ceasefire-agreemen.recent: Bets rose after Witkoff met Putin and the Kremlin confirmed talks in Abu Dhabi, the same day Melania Trump announced a local truce for Oleshky. They fell back as Putin said he wanted a final settlement, not a "short" truce, his aide asked for a seat for Europe, and Lavrov said the war would continue and likely escalate.

poly-predictfun-fdv-above-1b-one-day-aft.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Predict.fun's token, once it launches, has a fully diluted valuation above $1 billion on its first full day. That is the price of every token that will ever exist, not only those already trading.
poly-predictfun-fdv-above-1b-one-day-aft.recent: The fortnight's prediction-market news was about rivals and regulators: Robinhood traders moving beyond sports, a Pentagon memo on insider bets, and the Kalshi CEO arguing against state-led oversight. None of it concerned Predict.fun or its launch, and none of it explains the contract's price.

poly-us-announces-end-of-iranian-blockad.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the United States lifts its blockade of Iran before the end of 2026. Traders are betting on a settlement of the war, and with it on whether shipping returns to the Strait of Hormuz.
poly-us-announces-end-of-iranian-blockad.recent: In mid-October the talk in Washington turned to the 'Mother of All Bombs' the US could use in Iran. Since then the Pentagon has readied strikes for after the midterms, Trump said they could come as soon as Sunday, Khamenei backed Iran's war conditions for peace talks, and Tehran threatened Sinokor's tankers for breaking its Hormuz transit rules.

wiki-luiz-inacio-lula-da-silva.standing: How many people read the Wikipedia article on Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva each day. He is a former metalworker and union leader who founded Brazil's Workers' Party and has been elected the country's president more than once.
wiki-luiz-inacio-lula-da-silva.recent: Lula overturned a first-round deficit to beat Flávio Bolsonaro in the runoff by 4.4 million votes, after polls had his rival ahead 51% to 49%. Real futures fell 10% on the result. Bolsonaro then left Brazil through no regular border post, and Trump aide Simon Levy confirmed asylum in the US; Lula called it 'shameful'.

stocks:CVX.standing: The second-largest American oil major, pumping crude and gas from the Permian Basin to Kazakhstan and Australia and refining it into fuel. Its shares follow the oil price, and its dividend draws income investors.
stocks:CVX.recent: The one story about its own business was a disclosure question: its Nigerian unit and Shell's reported identical methane emissions for 2022. Nothing in that accounts for the share's rise.

poly-will-puma-shen-win-the-next-taipei-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Puma Shen, a Democratic Progressive Party legislator, is elected mayor of Taipei. The capital has elected a DPP mayor once since direct votes began in 1994, so it prices the party's reach there.

stocks:AAPL.standing: Shares of the Cupertino maker of the iPhone, Mac and iPad, one of the world's most valuable listed companies. The iPhone earns most of its revenue, and its products are assembled largely in China on chips made in Taiwan.
stocks:AAPL.recent: The climb came as iPhone Duo pre-orders opened and the phone was soon backordered until 2027, and as Apple Intelligence entered China running on Alibaba's Qwen models. Late in the month Apple said it would replace iPhone Duo units showing screen problems, then launched M6 MacBook Pro and iMac models.

stocks:ISP.MI.standing: Italy's largest bank by assets, listed in Milan, with a dominant share of the country's retail deposits and a big book of Italian government bonds, so its shares move with Italian sovereign risk.
stocks:ISP.MI.recent: The ECB gave Intesa Sanpaolo authorisation to take over Monte dei Paschi, clearing the way for a €32 billion bid. That approval came only this week, after the shares had already slid, and nothing else in the input explains the earlier fall.

stocks:002415.SZ.standing: The world's largest maker of video-surveillance cameras, listed in Shenzhen and controlled by state-owned CETC. US sanctions and Western bans on its gear in government sites limit what it can sell abroad.

stocks:BMPS.MI.standing: The Siena lender founded in 1472, the oldest bank still operating. The Italian state rescued it in 2017, and its fate has since been a test of how far Italy's banks will consolidate.
stocks:BMPS.MI.recent: The ECB authorised Intesa Sanpaolo to take over Monte dei Paschi, which clears Italy's largest bank to bid €32 billion for the Siena lender. The approval came at the end of the period, and nothing reported before it accounts for the share's earlier fall.

stocks:002236.SZ.standing: One of China's two largest makers of surveillance cameras and video systems, based in Hangzhou. US export blacklisting and an FCC equipment ban shut it out of American markets, so its sales lean on China and emerging markets.

stocks:000063.SZ.standing: China's second-largest telecom equipment maker after Huawei, based in Shenzhen and listed there and in Hong Kong. A 2018 US export ban nearly shut it down, so its shares move on Washington's rules on chips.

poly-flavio-bolsonaro-charged-or-arreste.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Flávio Bolsonaro, Brazilian senator and eldest son of former president Jair Bolsonaro, is charged or arrested before its deadline. It tracks how far Brazil's courts reach into the family.

poly-will-google-have-the-best-ai-model-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if a Google model holds first place on the LMArena text leaderboard when the month closes. It is a running bet on the race among Google, OpenAI, Anthropic and xAI for the top chatbot.

poly-will-the-fed-increase-interest-rate.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the Federal Reserve raises rates by a quarter point at its December 2026 meeting. Its price is what traders stake on another hike, which reaches mortgages, the dollar and Treasury yields.
poly-will-the-fed-increase-interest-rate.recent: In Bangkok, Fed Chair Warsh called AI a shock to the economy and gave no guidance on the next move. The Fed was expected to pause its hikes at Wednesday's meeting while signalling December, with oil near a six-month high. TD Securities expected 3 dissents against the hold.

stocks:COIN.standing: The largest US cryptocurrency exchange, listed on Nasdaq. Most of its revenue comes from trading fees and custody, so its shares move with crypto prices and how much people trade.
stocks:COIN.recent: Coinbase, which holds about 5% of all bitcoin for clients, urged bitcoin to migrate to quantum-resistant cryptography, and on 2026-10-28 said a vendor had exposed the contact details of a "small subset" of customers. The leak came after the last close, and neither it nor the warning accounts for the fall.

stocks:AMPL.standing: Amplitude sells product-analytics software that records how people use apps and websites, so companies can see which features keep customers. Its subscription revenue rises and falls with corporate software budgets.

stocks:RELIANCE.NS.standing: India's most valuable company, controlled by Mukesh Ambani: the world's largest refining complex at Jamnagar, the Jio telecom network and a vast retail chain. Its shares move with refining margins and Indian consumer demand.
stocks:RELIANCE.NS.recent: The fortnight belonged to Jio Platforms, the telecom arm Reliance floated in India's largest initial public offering: the issue filled in 100 minutes, and the shares rose 21.4% on their debut. Rubio meanwhile pressed India's refineries to process more Venezuelan crude, tying its Russian oil waiver to a trade deal.
